MI704 points list and MI705 3.2.2: supply fans on VFDs, RA damper modulated, CHW coil only. Treated outdoor air comes from the DOAH and relief air goes back to it; the DOAH controller modulates the relief damper (MI702 AO07, MI703 3.2.1.9). So the AHU has no OA, minimum-OA or relief damper and no economizer of its own. Freezestat, high static and duct smoke are wired in series to the VFD safety contacts; the SA duct smoke detector is monitored (BI6). NAVFAC, MCAS Cherry Point (DoD): UFC 3-410-01 applies.
